fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential suspicious applet or osascript executing "osacompile".
fields.name: Osacompile Execution By Potentially Suspicious Applet/Osascript
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and ((src.process.image.path contains "/applet" or src.process.image.path contains "/osascript") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "osacompile"))
